When n=3k+1, the unused label exchanges with any leaf after center flip and the two-K2 type attaches to singleton type; all configurations connected. When n=3k+2, legal two-step exchanges between the distinguished K2 and any triple plus internal center changes allow arbitrary block permutations; connectedness follows. Counting block partitions and local swaps yields formulae and degrees 2k, 8k or 10k−2, and 6k.
